description: Line ~1194 in pkix-path/src/lib.rs: '// RFC 5280 §6.1.2: NameConstraints state (wired up in PKIX-fr4).' PKIX-fr4 does not exist in beads. A contributor reading this doesn't know if PKIX-fr4 was completed, renamed, or is still pending. The comment should either (a) describe the current limitation plainly: '// TODO: also seed nc_permitted/nc_excluded from the trust anchor cert's NameConstraints extension (RFC 5280 §6.1.2); currently ignored.' or (b) reference the correct open issue if one is filed.
title: Dead issue reference 'PKIX-fr4' in chain_walk comment is meaningless to contributors
